title: run skill does not advance signal status from spec_written to candidate on successful candidate tag creation
description: When run.skill.md Phase 9 successfully creates a candidate tag, the corresponding signal's status field is not updated from 'spec_written' to 'candidate'. This means the signal index diverges from actual run state: a signal appears to still be awaiting a run even after one has succeeded. There is no call to fix_signal or tag_signal at the point of candidate tag creation in run.skill.md.
proposed_resolution: Add a step to run.skill.md Phase 9, after create_candidate_tag succeeds: call fix_signal (or a new update_signal_status MCP tool) to advance the signal status from 'spec_written' to 'candidate'. Include the candidate_tag value in the signal update. This should be gated on the candidate tag creation succeeding — if the QA gate fails, the status must not be advanced.
